query: SELECT CASE WHEN content LIKE '%|>%' OR content LIKE '%─▶│─%' OR content LIKE '%-->|%' OR content LIKE '%Anode%Cathode%' THEN 'has_symbol' ELSE 'no_symbol' END as symbol_check, CASE WHEN content LIKE '%schematic%' OR content LIKE '%symbol%' THEN 'mentions_schematic' ELSE 'no_mention' END as schematic_mention FROM course_lessons WHERE id = '60013';
